Asaan Finance: Programme Introduction

Asaan Finance is a digital financing application designed for Pakistan, providing users with easy, fast, and secure financial solutions when needed.

Our goal is to provide immediate financial assistance in the easiest and most secure way, through interest-free financing on easy installments, for Pakistanis tired of the complex traditional banking system. For any sudden need or business requirement, you can apply for a financing from the comfort of your home within minutes.

Complete legal protection that keeps you safe from illegal apps in the market. Interest-free financing with transparent terms (no hidden charges). A specific initial limit for new clients, while the financing limit is increased for repeat clients who repay on time.

The approved amount is transferred directly to your EasyPaisa, JazzCash, or Bank Account. Protection of your personal data and privacy is prioritized according to applicable laws and regulations.

The mission of Asaan Finance is to make digital financing transparent, affordable, and easy in Pakistan. We value the loyalty of our repeat customers and provide them with better financial facilities so they don\'t have to wander elsewhere in difficult times.

آسان فنانس: پروگرام کا تعارف

آسان فنانس پاکستان کے لیے ڈیزائن کی گئی ایک ڈیجیٹل فنانسنگ ایپلی کیشن ہے، جو صارفین کو ضرورت کے وقت آسان، تیز، اور محفوظ مالی حل فراہم کرتی ہے۔

ہمارا مقصد ان پاکستانیوں کو سب سے آسان اور محفوظ طریقے سے، آسان اقساط پر بلا سود فنانسنگ کے ذریعے فوری مالی امداد فراہم کرنا ہے جو پیچیدہ روایتی بینکاری نظام سے تنگ ہیں۔ کسی بھی اچانک ضرورت یا کاروباری تقاضے کے لیے، آپ گھر بیٹھے چند منٹوں میں فنانسنگ کے لیے اپلائی کر سکتے ہیں۔

مکمل قانونی تحفظ جو آپ کو مارکیٹ میں موجود غیر قانونی ایپس سے محفوظ رکھتا ہے۔ بلا سود فنانسنگ اور شفاف شرائط (کوئی پوشیدہ چارجز نہیں)۔ نئے کلائنٹس کے لیے ایک مخصوص ابتدائی حد، جبکہ وقت پر ادائیگی کرنے والے پرانے کلائنٹس کے لیے فنانسنگ کی حد بڑھا دی جاتی ہے۔

منظور شدہ رقم براہ راست آپ کے ایزی پیسہ، جاز کیش، یا بینک اکاؤنٹ میں منتقل کی جاتی ہے۔ آپ کے ذاتی ڈیٹا اور رازداری کے تحفظ کو قابل اطلاق قوانین اور ضوابط کے مطابق ترجیح دی جاتی ہے۔

آسان فنانس کا مشن پاکستان میں ڈیجیٹل لینڈنگ کو شفاف، سستا اور آسان بنانا ہے۔ ہم اپنے پرانے اور وفادار صارفین کی قدر کرتے ہیں اور انہیں بہتر مالی سہولیات فراہم کرتے ہیں تاکہ انہیں مشکل وقت میں کہیں اور بھٹکنا نہ پڑے۔

I guarantee that I will abide by the following agreement.

1.		The NRSP facility will not be available to members who, themselves or any member of their household, have obtained any kind of financing in cash or kind from a government or non-government institution and have not repaid it.
2.		The customer guarantees to use the financing properly and ensure the timely recovery of their own as well as their group/organization members' financing by the due date.
3.		In case the customer fails to repay the financing on time, the NRSP institution will take legal action against the customer and will be authorized to collect the principal amount along with court expenses, including lawyer's fees.
4.		The customer will deposit the recovery amount in the bank/agent (HBL Konnect, Easy Paisa, Jazz Cash) and if deposited with the institution's representative, will obtain a receipt. If the customer deposits the recovery amount with an agent (HBL Konnect, Easy Paisa, Jazz Cash), they should not leave the mobile agent's shop until the code is received, otherwise the institution will not be responsible.
5.		Profit: The customer will be obligated to pay profit on the financing amount according to NRSP policy.
6.		Takaful is provided with specific financing.
7.		The customer will not obtain any kind of stay order from any court and will not take any legal action.
8.		If the customer files any false or frivolous civil or criminal case against the institution, they will be obligated to pay damages and expenses to the institution.
9.		In the event of the death of a household member of the customer, NRSP will postpone the financing installment for 7 days.
10.		NRSP will not provide information related to the customer and their household to any institution or individual. However, NRSP will be bound to provide this information to the institutions of the Government of Pakistan.
11.		The customer permits NRSP to use their photograph and other credentials in various reports to promote the financing program.
12.		The customer will have the right to complain to the higher officials of NRSP against unnecessary difficulties during the acquisition and repayment of the financing.
13.		The member and guarantor will provide all possible help and cooperation to the NRSP staff to review the use of the financing.
14.		I acknowledge that the institution's staff has informed me of all my responsibilities and rights.
15.		The NRSP institution will take a post-dated check from the customer as a guarantee. Upon repayment of the financing, the NRSP institution will be obligated to cancel and return the check upon the customer's demand.
16.		If the customer changes or closes their place of business during the financing period, the NRSP institution will have the right to recover all outstanding amounts (principal amount along with profit) from the customer.
17.		The customer will use the financing amount only for the stated purpose. And if any of the provided information proves to be false, the institution is authorized to stop the provision of the financing and can take action according to the rules and regulations in case of any forgery or concealment of facts.
18.		According to the laws of Pakistan, the customer will not use the financing for illegal activities, forced/child labor, black money, bribery, terrorism, gambling, damage to forests, business of weapons/alcohol/tobacco, use of prohibited medicines for crops like Capta, and harming protected animal species.
19.		I will have no objection if NRSP verifies my identity card information through Verisys from NADRA.

Privacy Policy – Asaan Finance
Last updated: 16 October 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how the National Rural Support Programme (NRSP) (\"NRSP\", \"we\", \"our\" or \"us\") collects, uses, shares and protects your information when you use the Asaan Finance mobile app (the \"App\"). The App lets you apply for and manage interest-free micro-financing from NRSP.

By registering for or using the App, you agree to this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.

1. Information We Collect
A. Information you give us
• Identity details: full name, CNIC number, CNIC issue and expiry dates, date of birth, gender and marital status.
• Contact details: mobile number, present and permanent address, district and tehsil.
• Photos: your profile photo and photos of the front and back of your CNIC.
• Bank details: bank name, account number, branch code and branch address.
• Financing details: purpose, amount and duration of financing, business or occupation details, source of income and nearest NRSP branch city.
• Payments: receipt photos and details you submit for manual payments.
• Support: feedback, attachments and the messages or voice questions you send to the in-app assistants.
B. Information collected automatically
• A notification token (Google Firebase Cloud Messaging) so we can send you updates about your application.
• Your device ID at registration, and basic technical information (such as app version and device model) needed to keep the App working.
The App does not show advertisements and does not use your location.

2. App Permissions
• Camera: to scan your CNIC and take your profile photo or a payment receipt photo.
• Photos / media: to choose a CNIC photo, profile photo or receipt from your gallery.
• Microphone: only while you use voice mode in the assistants. Your speech is converted to text by your phone\'s speech service.
• Notifications: to tell you about application status and payments.
• Internet: to send your application and load your financing records.
You can withdraw any permission in your phone\'s settings; some features will then stop working.

3. How We Use Your Information
• To create and manage your account and verify your identity.
• To receive, assess and process your financing application, including eligibility checks such as existing NRSP financing, repeat-client status, NADRA biometric verification and AML/CFT screening.
• To disburse financing, record repayments and show your Financing Ledger.
• To send notifications about your application and payments.
• To answer your questions, handle feedback and provide support.
• To prevent fraud and meet our legal and regulatory obligations.
• To improve the App.

4. AI Features
CNIC scanning and the in-app assistants use Google Gemini, a service of Google LLC, to read the details on your CNIC and to understand and answer your questions. CNIC photos and the messages you send to the assistants are sent to Google for this processing. Please do not share passwords, PINs or OTPs with the assistants; NRSP never asks for them.

5. Sharing Your Information
We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with:
• NRSP staff and branches who process your application and financing.
• Banks and payment channels used for disbursement and repayment.
• NADRA, regulators and law enforcement authorities when required by law.
• Service providers who help us run the App: Google Firebase (notifications) and Google Gemini (AI features).

6. Data Security
We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information against unauthorised access, loss or misuse. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

7. Data Retention
We keep your information while your account is active and for as long as required by law and NRSP\'s record-keeping rules for financial records, after which it is deleted or anonymised.

8. Your Rights
• Access: ask for a copy of the information we hold about you.
• Correction: update your profile in the App (Settings, Update Profile) or ask us to correct it.
• Deletion: ask us to delete your account. Financing and repayment records may be kept where the law requires it.
To make a request, email mer_dojlm@yahoo.com with the subject \"Data Deletion Request\" or \"Data Access Request\". We will respond within 14 business days.

9. Children
The App is for adults aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

10. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy. When we do, we will change the \"Last updated\" date above. Continuing to use the App after an update means you accept the updated policy.

11. Contact Us
• Organisation: National Rural Support Programme (NRSP)
• Email: mer_dojlm@yahoo.com
• WhatsApp / Phone: +92 302 8582454
